Building U.S. Investor Access Behind U.S. Commercial Momentum

The OTCQB listing comes less than six weeks after Algo8 began trading on the CSE on October 13, 2026. It is a deliberate next step in the Company's capital markets strategy: a significant and growing share of Algo8's commercial pipeline sits with North American industrial operators, and the OTCQB provides a regulated, transparent venue for the U.S. investors who know those customers best.

Algo8's Industrial AI Operating System connects the operational and business systems customers already run from plant-floor controllers and historians to MES and ERP and combines industrial context with generative, agentic, predictive and physical AI. The platform has been deployed more than 80 times across large-scale manufacturing, energy and infrastructure operations, where customers use it to optimize production scheduling, maintenance, quality, energy use and throughput. The Company's investor base includes a strategic investment from Chemelex, a Brookfield portfolio company that is also an Algo8 customer.

"Listing on the OTCQB makes Algo8 more accessible to U.S. investors as we continue to work with U.S. industrial customers, and we believe a U.S. trading presence will increase our visibility with those customers, our channel partners and the institutions that follow the industrial technology space," said Brandon Kou, President of Algo8.
